eligibility: One SOLVED interpretation; all genomic interpretations CAUSATIVE and belonging to one gene; one or two unique explicit hg38 small-variant records; canonical autosome or X; nonempty unequal ACGT REF/ALT shorter than 50 bases; matching known GENO ID/label; >=3 distinct present HPO features; at least one PubMed external reference. Exclude unsupported zygosity/sex configurations and the prior FGFR2 example or BUB1B. Do not use predicted pathogenicity, frequency, known gene score, Exomiser availability, or any analysis result to select.
selection: Within each quota stratum, sort eligible gene symbols by SHA256(seed|gene|stratum|symbol); select first genes not already selected. For each gene sort eligible source member paths by SHA256(seed|case|member), choose first. Do not replace failed cases after execution; report exclusions/failures.

arms.original: All distinct non-excluded source HPO features; source diagnosis and gene are withheld from phenotype input.
arms.half_missing: Keep ceil(N/2) HPO features by SHA256(seed|drop|case_id|hpo_id), without score inspection.
arms.swapped: Order selected cases by SHA256(seed|donor|case_id); cyclic next case is donor. Use its complete observed HPO set. This is a phenotype-perturbation control, not a healthy biological negative.
arms.none: Empty HPO list. This is the no-phenotype baseline, not an unsolved/healthy patient.

analysis_boundary: This freezes public case selection and perturbations only. Runtime/configuration/background and result evaluation are handled separately by parent. Causal-only VCFs are spike ingredients, not a diagnostic ranking benchmark; no causal-only top-1 claim is meaningful. Knowledge leakage remains possible because these published cases may contribute to HPO/OMIM and pathogenicity databases. Two heterozygous variants are encoded unphased; this script does not establish trans phase. Strata are observed genotype patterns, not independently adjudicated inheritance modes.
